$comment: VERBATIM CAPTURE of one real run of the M2-P3 full-suite wrapper (kernel plan M3 section 2.3 rule 4, T-003 lesson 4). wrapper-capture.counts.json and wrapper-capture.stdout.txt in this directory are the wrapper's own evidence files, copied byte for byte and edited in no way. This file records HOW they were produced, so a reader can tell a capture from an authored string: it names the command, the exit code the command returned, the working directory and the HEAD the run was made at. The result path and evidence directory were under a scratch directory outside the repository and are written as placeholders here because their absolute paths are container-specific and carry no information; nothing else is elided.
